title: Waves
description: A VR shooter: hold the crystal against five levels of waves — grunts, runners and tanks pouring out of the portals. Pick a gun and an ability; shoot them down before they reach it.
author: theprototype

elements.label: Five levels of enemies pour out of the portals. Pick your gun, hold the crystal.
Trigger / click: shoot  ·  Grip / Q: ability  ·  P: pause
SHOOT — pull the trigger (desktop: click). The gun is in your right hand; switch hands in Options.
HOLD THE CRYSTAL — enemies walk from the portals to it. One that reaches it explodes: −2 crystal. At zero the run is lost.
ABILITY — squeeze the grip on your free hand (desktop: Q): Shield, Slow-mo or Pulse. Then it recharges.
LEVELS — every 3 waves is a new level: runners, then tanks, then faster. Higher levels score more.
Semi-auto. One precise bolt per pull.
7 pellets, slow pump. Brutal up close.
Hold to burn. Overheats — let it cool.
Blocks all crystal damage for 3 s.
Tap a setting to change it. Saved on this device.
